what_happened: Prototyped the signal-file-based fix for case 1's releaser race (PATH-shimmed bare sleep in cmd_acquire_retry touches a marker file on its first invocation, then a background releaser polls for that marker instead of sleeping a fixed 0.3s before removing the foreign lock). Reproduced the original race 3/3 times under a 28-worker yes-loop load (avg load 10.5-30.8) using the dispatch's own reproduction method, then confirmed the patched prototype passed all 14 cases 3/3 times under comparable-to-higher load (up to 27.8 1-min load avg), and passed cleanly unloaded. Strong empirical confirmation the fix removes the race by construction rather than by widening a margin.

Research arrived with an empirically validated fix prototype (3/3 clean under load matching and exceeding the dispatch's reproduction range, 14/14 cases) plus three named silent-failure traps for the implementer (command-scoped PATH prefix, real-sleep shim, REAL_SLEEP captured pre-override). Planning needed no design exploration and no needs_research round; the phases are sequencing and verification discipline around an already-proven diff.

Phase 1 RED baseline reproduced the reported Case 1 race on the first two induced-load attempts (loads 18.33 and 23.66, within/above the dispatch's 12.6-20.5 range), each with the exact expected failure signature and Cases 2-13 passing cleanly -- no extra attempts needed.
